title: Delegations (OOO): the Delegator can only be the signed-in user, but the field starts at "Select…" and a search for a colleague answers "No options found" with no reason — prefill it and say why (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U04)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 委托（外出）表单的委托人只能是当前登录用户，但字段默认空白，搜同事只显示「无选项」，不说明原因。
- **要做：** 默认填当前用户，并在字段下说明「只能委托你自己的审批」。
- **完成标准：** 打开表单即已填好委托人，看得懂为什么不能选别人。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U04**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Delegations (OOO), the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** the Delegator is limited to the signed-in admin, but the field starts at "Select…", and searching for a colleague answers "No options found".
- **Cost:** the picker hides why the colleague cannot be chosen; an admin covering for someone has no hint.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-04; [`22-F14-delegations-search-other-no-options.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/22-F14-delegations-search-other-no-options.png). It follows #24764 (closed), which limited the picker.

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-delegation.object.ts` `delegator_id` (~:98–104): `lookupFilters: [{ field: 'id', operator: 'eq', value: '{current_user_id}' }]`, no default, and a description that does not say only you can be chosen. Pinned in `sys-approval-delegation-delegator-picker.test.ts`.

## Done when

- New Delegation opens with the Delegator set to the signed-in user.
- The field's help says only your own approvals can be delegated.
- The existing picker pin plus one for the default.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `delegat`. 2 open hits: #25280 (a delegation's organization scope) and #25251 (a security gate). Not this form. **New.**
